No. Tamers cannot attack, so a [Marcus Damon] Tamer in the battle area can't attack. However, if an effect such as the one on [BT12-092 Marcus Damon] causes it to be treated as a Digimon, then it is able to attack.

Card Q&A.a: No, effects that target Digimon can't target a [Marcus Damon] that's just a Tamer in the battle area.
Card Q&A.q: When an effect that targets Digimon with 3000 DP or less is activated, can a [Marcus Damon] that gains +3000 DP from this card's [Your Turn] effect be chosen as a target for that effect?

Card Q&A.a: This effect is not an effect with a set duration such as "for the turn," so the effect is lost unless the Digimon's name is still [Marcus Damon] after digivolving.
Card Q&A.q: My [Marcus Damon] digivolved into a Digimon with a "you may digivolve as if your Tamer is a level 3 Digimon" effect. In such cases, what happens to the +3000 DP/ that [Marcus Damon] gained from this card's [Your Turn] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, Tamers can't have DP, so it's not treated as a Tamer with 3000 DP.
